summary: This program builds a list of farmers' market products and then uses a stream pipeline to pick out the organic items sold in summer, order them from cheapest to most expensive, and collect just their names into a list of strings.

lines.text: Comparator supplies the ready-made sorting rules used later to order products by price.
Collectors provides the recipe that gathers the finished stream back into an ordinary List.
This is the source of data for the whole program; a stream never stores elements itself, it always reads from a collection like this one.

lines.code: products.add(new MarketProduct("Heirloom Tomatoes", "Sunny Fields Farm", 4.50, "Produce", "Summer", true));
lines.text: Each product carries a name, vendor, price, category, season, and an organic flag, which are exactly the fields the stream pipeline will filter and sort on.

lines.code: products.add(new MarketProduct("Wildflower Honey", "Bee Kind Apiary", 12.00, "Honey", "Late Summer", true));
lines.text: The season here is "Late Summer" rather than "Summer", which is why the filter tests for a substring instead of an exact match.
A plain loop prints the full inventory first, so you can compare the old style with the stream version below.
The stream work is kept in its own method, so main stays readable and the pipeline can be reused or tested on any list.
The method name states the whole pipeline in order: filter to organic summer items, sort by price, return names.
Calling stream() on the list opens the pipeline; the original list is never modified by anything that follows.
The lambda keeps only products that pass the test, and the null check guards against a missing season before toLowerCase is called on it.
comparingDouble builds a comparator from the price getter, ordering the surviving items from lowest price to highest.
map converts each MarketProduct into its name, so the stream changes from a stream of products to a stream of strings.
collect is the terminal operation that actually runs the pipeline and packages the results into a List<String>.
